label: Individual Handmade Parts
description: A jacket with individual handmade parts combines machine sewing for long structural seams with hand work concentrated on the areas where it matters most: pad-stitching the lapels and collar canvas, hand-setting the sleeves into the armhole, hand-finishing the buttonholes, and hand-attaching the lining at its edges. This hybrid approach is the norm for the majority of high-quality bespoke and premium made-to-measure houses and delivers much of the softness, shape retention, and sartorial character of full handmade at a more practical time investment. It is the standard most discerning wearers associate with the term 'bespoke.'
